reason: Grafana's MySQL DSN is built with `clientFoundRows=true` (pkg/services/sqlstore/sqlstore.go:287), so `RowsAffected()` at pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/anonstore/database.go:90-96 returns matched rows, not changed rows, and an existing device with unchanged values still yields 1. Only the raw `connection_string` override, commented as a special case for integration tests (sqlstore.go:275-277), bypasses this flag.
